subject: Login issue update
text:
Hi,

Following up on your last reply. I reinstalled the app, signed out, and tried again on my phone, but the login still stops at the loading screen. I also cleared the cache and tried incognito mode, but neither option helped. I still see the spinning circle after. I also tried the desktop version and got the same message. It only happens when I use the work network, not my home Wi-Fi. I need to access the dashboard before the audit meeting this afternoon. Can you check whether the permissions changed, or send a new session link? If you need my account ID, it is on the receipt.

Thanks,
